# XCCEL8 Advanced Solutions LLC

> One-stop full-stack IT solutions provider in Dubai, UAE, serving SMEs across the UAE and GCC, with free consultation, expert implementation, and long-term AMC support.

## About

XCCEL8 Advanced Solutions LLC is a Dubai-based IT solutions company serving SMEs across the UAE and GCC. We cover four pillars: Network Infrastructure, Business Applications, Compute & Cloud, and Cyber + Physical Security. We are authorized resellers for Microsoft, Zoho, Fortinet, Sophos, Lenovo, Honeywell, and 95+ other brands.

- **Location:** Al Nahda, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

## Services

### Network Infrastructure
Wi-Fi, switching & routing, structured cabling, IP telephony, conference room solutions, laptops and endpoints.
https://www.xccel8.com/network/

### Business Applications
Zoho (Books, CRM, People, Creator), Microsoft 365, ERP/CRM/HRMS implementation, accounting software, e-invoicing (UAE FTA-compliant via MoF-accredited ASP).
https://www.xccel8.com/application/

AI consulting & implementation sits within this pillar — AI agents integrated with business workflows, process discovery, AI solution design, implementation, and support. Serving UAE & GCC, 100% online.
https://www.xccel8.com/services/ai-consulting/

Website design & development — branded business websites, e-commerce and web applications, designed and approved before build.

https://www.xccel8.com/services/mobile-apps/

https://www.xccel8.com/security/

SEO, GEO & AEO optimisation — technical, on-page and local SEO, AI-search visibility and answer-first content.
